title: Constantly curved minimal immersions of the two-sphere in unitary groups
summary: In this article, we investigate rigidity results for constantly curved minimal immersions of the two-sphere $S^2$ into the unitary group $\mathrm{U}(n)$. Using loop group methods for harmonic maps, we establish a correspondence between such immersions and a distinguished class of constantly curved holomorphic immersions of $S^2$ into finite-dimensional Grassmannians.
